text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text: Their success also marked the dawn of a new era.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
A generation that brought forth many great blooms from the Tiara.
Those flowers were truly unique,
and bloomed in full glory in all kinds of places.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
However, it is unlikely that
she will ever speak of that history herself.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall write in their stead.
A casual retelling of history—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today is Saturday.
Tracen Academy is off, and there is no training.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, my trainee Chrono Genesis
is approaching her debut. Even if it's a day off,
I can't just spend it idly...
choice_data_list: (Alright, let's go watch the race!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arriving at Nakayama Racecourse,
I immediately head for the paddock. And then—
choice_data_list: Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? ...Huh?
Ah... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: H-Hello. Good work today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ran into Chrono Genesis, the Umamusume I train.
It was a coincidence—though since she spends almost every weekend
at the racetrack, you could also call it inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you here on academy business...?
Or... to watch the races?
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll do some race research. Your debut is coming up soon, after all!
Maybe I'll do some race research. Your debut is coming up soon, after all!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I see... The next race, Race 4, is 1800m on Dirt,
and the one after that, Race 5, is 2000m on Turf...
choice_data_list: Dirt or lunch first... Which should I choose...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm heading to the paddock, so...
Excuse me, I'll take my leave now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Dirt is different from Chrono Genesis's aptitudes.
However, watching various races will be educational.
There is no doubt it will benefit her future."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll save lunch for later and watch Race 4.
I decided to head over to the paddock myself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Outer gates have the advantage on Nakayama's dirt 1800m.
For front-runners and pacers, going outside is a no-brainer, but—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The two on the outside only have track records from coming from behind, huh.
Hmm... It's cloudy and the track is firm, so...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Based on data from similar conditions,
she'll likely take the lead right away and pull off a wire-to-wire win.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's a chance the outer gates
might push forward depending on the track...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how they're doing. In the final workout,
the two on the outside didn't look too great, but—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“—Number 11 on the outermost gate.
I can feel that she's about to make a move...!”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, the composure of No. 1 is hard to pass up.
If it doesn't get boxed in, No. 1 might be better..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...! Gaaah,
I can't decide... Number 11... No, Number 1 after all...
choice_data_list: (Sh-she's really agonizing over this...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They are probably predicting which Umamusume will win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems she's making predictions for the winning Umamusume so she doesn't miss a historic moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Regardless, I must check on the Umamusume's condition and apply it to my studies!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So you decided to just watch...
...Would you like to head to the front?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Wanna do it near the finish line?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, if possible.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, the camera exposure should be good around here.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to adjust the magnification when entering the track.
choice_data_list: That camera of yours is amazing as always...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?
H-How best to capture their very "lives"...
...I refuse to make any compromises on that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: In the presence of an Umamusume preparing for a race... all the hardships, passions, and everything else leading up to this moment bleed through...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to fully savor every ounce
of their bittersweet, intertwining drama...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I want to capture that sight in a photograph and preserve the moment history is woven...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I splurged a bit on the lens...
so it can capture photos packed with dynamic action.
choice_data_list: Huh, will you show me the photos you took next time?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: W-With pleasure...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And they're off!
Number 1 on the inside and Number 11 on the outside are off to great starts.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Number 11 closing in from the outside!
She pushes past to take the lead! In second place is Number 9!
choice_data_list: Continuous shooting?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Not even for a second... can I afford to lose focus!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Number 11 in the lead crosses the finish line! Followed by number 9 in second, and number 1 in third!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... What a divine expression before the finish line...
Laying bare an unvarnished obsession for victory...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Everything they had been up to this day
seeped through those few seconds...
choice_data_list: Looks like you took some great photos.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah...! S-Sorry. I got a little carried away...
choice_data_list: It's almost lunchtime, want to grab something to eat?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. At a place like this, it just has to be
the motsuni stew, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could we wait until after I take photos
of the Winner's Circle?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Are you here to watch the
Hanshin Umamusume Stakes too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You really can't miss the Main Race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, there were graded stakes races at both Nakayama and Hanshin.
I was planning to watch Hanshin's main race, the GII Hanshin Umamusume Stakes, on the Turf Vision.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I also... well, to be precise,
there's someone running that I've actually been keeping an eye on.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Number 3... it's Schön Lilie-san.
choice_data_list: Schöne Lilie, if I remember correctly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume from the generation two years above
Chrono Genesis, currently in her first Senior year.
choice_data_list: She's suffered a string of close defeats ever since the Junior Class, right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But I won
my previous race, the GIII Tokyo Shimbun Hai!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: If I can ride this wave of momentum, it might be my very first GII victory...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Truth be told...
I really wanted to go to Hanshin, but...!"
choice_data_list: Both time-wise and money-wise, that's pretty tough on students.
Time-wise and money-wise, it's tough on students, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... but
I'd like to see it through on the Turf Vision...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the Hanshin Umamusume Stakes gets underway!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Her positioning is good.
No wasted ground on the inside. If she can just break free...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the path opened up!
I can do this, all the way...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Just a little more...—Ah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
SchÃ¶n Lilie crossed the finish line,
just trailing behind the leader.
choice_data_list: 3rd place... so close.
3rd place... that was close, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like the girl wiping away tears on the Turf Vision screen,
Chrono Genesis's eyes
were also glistening with tears...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A close defeat might, in a sense, be harder to bear
than a total blowout.
And to have it happen again...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sure... she'll stand and face it again.
If it's Lilie-san, she will...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After watching the final race, I walked toward the exit side by side with Chrono Genesis.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was once again able to fully savor
a piece of newly made history...
choice_data_list: Looks like you were racking your brain over your predictions.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Seeing them in person brings back memories
of all the hardships endured to reach this point,
and the connections made with everyone around them...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what I should be
focusing on, you see...
choice_data_list: Right, was that what the victory prediction was for?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Historical dramas may be born around the victors, but...
there is passionate drama for every single Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if only there were a way
to savor every single bit of it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We made our way back home, chatting about nothing in particular.
Another ordinary weekend was drawing to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Chrono Genesis loves racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is fair to say I love not only running,
but the entirety of the history surrounding races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the weekends, she heads to the racetrack, reflecting on the hoofprints left by Umamusume of the past... and watching with sparkling eyes as new history is made.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What connected her and me was also history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was the writer of "Idle Musings, Historical Tales," a school newspaper column I loved reading.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dream is naturally
"to spin her own history and carve out her hoofprints."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like the many Umamusume who painted the epic scrolls of history,
she seeks to etch a brilliantly shining point upon the chronicles of racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the start of the week—
Chrono Genesis sent over the data.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-Based on the results of last week's training...
I have recalculated my winning probability
using the Genesis Method...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Genesis Method"—
It was her method for predicting winning Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "I'm predicting the winning Umamusume by analyzing according to the 'Genesis Method'..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The method takes into account various data from past races.
choice_data_list: All sorts of things... Like what, for example?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
First, we should look at races on the same course...
If the weather, track condition, and race pace are similar,
they often produce comparable results...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "However, even with identical objective data... the results will not be completely identical."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's physical and mental state also have a huge impact.
We take those into account when evaluating.
Things like final workouts and paddock reviews, for example.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In case of insufficient preparation, or if she pulls too hard...
I will refer to similar past cases for those as well.
choice_data_list: In other words, referencing a massive number of past races?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is correct.
choice_data_list: It's amazing you pulled that off when it's so hard to even find a similar race.
It's amazing you pulled that off when it's so hard to even find a similar race, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm terribly flattered...
And well, there's still more to it—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The most defining feature of my method...
is the 'Genesis Factor.'

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The Genesis Factor is—
roughly speaking, historical drama-like factors
that require consideration... I suppose."
choice_data_list: Historical drama... elements...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In racing, outcomes sometimes emerge
as if guided by history itself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Their devotion to the GⅠ, the clash between fated rivals—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The intertwining destinies of Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Passion for one's dream, a relentless tenacity to overcome any barrier...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I take into account factors that give rise to such historical drama.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
For instance... take the case of
Schön Lilie the other day—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Repeated near-misses coming just one step short...
Therefore, the "obsession with overcoming the barrier"
becomes a factor to consider...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And then there's 'fan support.'
That's also a major factor to consider!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because cheering can sometimes grant an Umamusume
enough power to overturn history itself!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "I sent over the updated detailed rationale for the 'Genesis Method' this morning..."
choice_data_list: Thanks for the commentary, Professor Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yes?
T-Teacher... is that you...?"
choice_data_list: N-No! I was just talking to myself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The win rates calculated through the "Genesis Method" are used as a reference when formulating training plans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Being able to look ahead at the races she wanted to enter in the future was also extremely useful for training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis's immediate major goal
is the Classic Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho—
To etch my name into the historic Tiara legacy...
That is what I want to strive for...
choice_data_list: You're not going for the Classic Triple Crown route?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... In all likelihood, when it comes to our generation,
Gran-chan and Love-chan
are both in a league of their own—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Without a doubt, she will leave her name in history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To compete with them and leave behind hoofprints
of undeniable strength...
I will walk the same Tiara path as they did!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward that goal, I'm putting together
this year's training plan as well.
choice_data_list: Hmm, looks like things are going smoothly!
Hmm, looks like things are going smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes... Though this is merely a prediction based on what we know at the moment...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I will devote myself to my training... so that I can grow just as predicted...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...And eventually,
I want to be just like the legendary Umamusume who made history."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: To etch... my hoofprints into history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I want to carve out a one-of-a-kind Chrono Genesis history...!
